cases.title: New learner opening on a busy comp

rubric.reason: The mentor opens with what it found (11 pairs across the layers) and a concrete proposal: "I'd start with **Title**, which has 4 pairs".
It proposes only Title and lists exactly 4 pairs. The other pairs appear only as a count ("11 keyframe pairs") and a list of layer names.
It names Old Take as hidden and says it's left out, and names Icon as a precomp it "can't see inside" while explicitly not saying it's fine.
Every layer (Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow, Old Take, Icon), property and time (0.5–1.5 s, 1.5–3 s) matches the snapshot_project output.
It called read_learner_record before snapshot_project and the record was empty. The mentor claims no history ("This is your first easing lesson") and never mentions the file or its fields.

cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: The mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the Title pairs (0.5–1.5 s), and the reply refers to what the frame shows (Title halfway through its first move, with the text faint mid-fade).

Layers, properties and times (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity, Old Take, Icon) all match snapshot output; the Title text described as 'An easing lesson' comes from the frame rather than the tool JSON and nothing contradicts it.

The mentor asks the learner to ease all four Title pairs and names them, but it also says 'If you'd like to watch me do one first, just ask', which is an offer to demonstrate rather than a clear request that the learner do the work; the pairs are named and no edits were made, though. On balance the learner is asked to try, so this should pass on the ask, yet the offer to demo is allowed (one set_ease on demo_target), so the failing basis is weak.

cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: The preview_frame call at time 1 s is inside the Title Position 0.5–1.5 s pair, but the mentor's reply never refers to what the frame shows, so the requirement that the reply refer to the frame is not met.
Only one set_ease was called, on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and the mentor ended with 'the rest is yours' naming the three remaining Title pairs and asking the learner to say 'done'.
All layers, properties and times mentioned (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp) match the snapshot results.

cases.title: "Do the rest" after the demo is declined

rubric.reason: After the single demo set_ease on demo_target, the mentor asked the learner to ease Title's Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s themselves, and in turn 3 it warmly declined 'do the rest for me' with a reason ('is how this sticks') and made no further edits.

cases.title: "Do it all" before any demo gets the first pair at most

rubric.reason: The mentor warmly refused 'ease all of it' with a reason ('Doing the easing yourself is how it sticks'), made no set_ease calls, and named the four Title pairs for the learner to ease, offering at most one demo of the first Position pair.

cases.title: A complete attempt passes and is recorded

rubric.reason: Every layer, property and time the mentor names (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale, Opacity, Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s, Bar, Glow, Old Take, Icon) matches the snapshot_project and diff_since_last results.

record_lesson has result 'passed' matching the diff (passed: true), demo_used true matches the set_ease call, attempted and summary rest on the diff results (three learner-eased pairs, demo pair, no unexpected changes) with no invented method, and no personal data appears.

cases.title: A partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the check showed Scale and Opacity as still_linear; the mentor named both layers, properties and times ("Scale, 0.5 s to 1.5 s", "Opacity, 0.5 s to 1.5 s"), said what to look for (keys still diamonds), made no set_ease call and did not offer to fix them.

In Turn 1 the mentor said "11 linear pairs across 6 layers", but the snapshot counts.linear is 10, so a count is invented; the layer, property and time names (Title, Position, Scale, Opacity, Subtitle, Old Take, Icon, 0.5–1.5 s, 1.5–3 s) otherwise match the tool results.

cases.title: An extra key on the wrong property is noted, not graded as easing

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor names the still-linear pairs (Position 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) with what to check, calls no set_ease on them, and does not offer to fix them.

The mentor says the demo 'only eased the side of that key facing the earlier pair' and that the Position 1.5 s key 'can look done because my demo touched it', but the check shows Position 1.5–3 s as plain still_linear and the demo eased only the 0.5–1.5 s pair, so this claim is invented and contradicts the tool results.

rubric.reason: The mentor called read_learner_record before snapshot_project, opened by mentioning the earlier Title work in plain words, did not re-teach basics for the 'learned' skill, and proposed Bar, which is the record's 'next', without naming the file or its fields.

The opening proposes a single layer (Bar) and names only 3 pairs (X Position 0–0.6 s and 0.6–1.2 s, Trim Paths End 0.2–1.2 s); the other counts are given as totals ('10 pairs across 5 visible layers').

All layers, properties and times mentioned (Title, Subtitle Opacity, Bar X Position 0–0.6 and 0.6–1.2 s, Trim Paths End 0.2–1.2 s under Contents, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, 10 linear pairs across 5 visible layers) match the snapshot_project output.

cases.title: A returning learner picks up what was still wrong

rubric.reason: The mentor called read_learner_record before snapshot_project, opened by recalling the earlier Title work in plain words ('eased its Position. Scale and Opacity were still linear... and they still are'), and proposed Title's Scale and Opacity, matching the practicing record, without mentioning the file or field names.

Every layer, property and time named (Title, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, Logo Scale single key, Logo Rotation expression, 8 linear and 1 half-done pair on 6 layers) matches the snapshot_project and learner record output.

cases.title: AE stops answering at the check

rubric.reason: After diff_since_last returned AE_UNREACHABLE, the mentor said "I can't see your project right now, so I can't tell you whether the pairs pass. I'm not going to guess," gave no verdict, count or layer description, and passed on the check until the learner says done again.

cases.title: A different comp is active at the check

rubric.reason: After diff_since_last returned comp_matches:false, the mentor said it can't check because a different comp is showing, named the lesson comp 'Mentor Practice', gave no verdict or pair counts, and deferred the check.

cases.title: A comp with nothing linear doesn't get an invented problem

rubric.reason: The mentor names only 'Comp 1', which appears in the snapshot, and the 'four keyframe pairs' count matches eased: 4. The shape layer and 0.5 s/1.5 s Position keys are a suggestion for the learner to create, not claims about the existing project.
